notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33298668/a2f9e30176350eb90024665627f11c500d5642b6.png

Steve is keeping seasonal and really fancied a pumpkin spiced helmet. I told him, that wasn't a thing, but, he wanted one anyway. There also appears to be lots of sweets to collect in the different worlds! 

A few optimisations have taken place in this update and a few bug fixes. 

• Checkpoints now reset on restart of level
• Sorted star awards for all levels - all are now working properly.
• Added visual effects; 
          - Chromatic Aberration
          - Vignette
          - Bloom
• When you hit an enemy you get feedback to differentiate between not hitting an enemy.
• Fixed a couple of typos in the subtitles.
• Added animation to the UI for some menu pages.

Also, there is a sale coming up soon...... (winking face)
